title: Open universal classical ECDLP target
question: Is there a universal uniform classical algorithm solving ECDLP over arbitrary elliptic curves over finite fields in worst-case O(n log n) bit operations, with n the total encoded input length?
rationale: Primary mission supplied by the user; aspirational open target, not a known achievable bound.
assumptions: Classical uniform computation; arbitrary finite fields and elliptic curves.
n is total encoded input length, including representations and problem parameters.
Do not assume a polynomial-time or near-linear algorithm exists.
next_action: Specify the exact ECDLP input/output promise, field encoding, subgroup assumptions and bit/memory model before proposing general bounds.
notes: Goal only. No theorem, algorithm, experimental support or independent validation established.
